frame.name: Precision Frame
frame.description:
Compound Bow. Longer draw time optimized for damage. 
[Reload]  : Use while drawn to cancel the shot.

origins.name: Problem Solver
origins.description:
Dealing sustained damage to Champion, miniboss, or boss combatants exhausts them and grants this weapon handling and reload speed.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.

origins.name: Vanguard Determination
origins.description: After using your class ability, final blows with this weapon grant you bonus damage resistance.

origins.name: Wild Card
origins.description: Final blows with this weapon have a chance to create experimental submunitions at the target's location.

perks.name: Firefly
perks.description: Precision kills with this weapon increase reload speed and cause the target to explode, dealing Solar damage to nearby enemies.

enhanced.name: Firefly
enhanced.description: Precision final blows with this weapon substantially increase reload speed and cause the target to explode, dealing Solar damage to nearby targets.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

enhanced.name: Successful Warm-Up
enhanced.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed for an improved duration.

perks.name: Impulse Amplifier
perks.description: Massively increases projectile velocity, increases reload speed.

enhanced.name: Impulse Amplifier
enhanced.description: Massively increases projectile velocity, substantially increases reload speed.

perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.description: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

enhanced.name: Rapid Hit
enhanced.description: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed substantially.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.description:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

enhanced.name: Incandescent
enhanced.description:
Defeating a target spreads a longer lasting scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

perks.name: Transcendent Moment
perks.description: Final blows grant bonus stats based on the weapon's damage type alignment. Light elements grant stability and handling. Dark elements grant range and aim assist. While Transcendent, this weapon gets both bonuses.

enhanced.name: Transcendent Moment
enhanced.description: Final blows grant bonus stats based on the weapon's damage type alignment. Light elements grant improved stability and handling. Dark elements grant improved range and aim assist. While Transcendent, this weapon gets both bonuses.

perks.name: Burning Ambition
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage scorches the target. Dealing damage to a scorched target inflicts scorch.

enhanced.name: Burning Ambition
enhanced.description: Dealing sustained damage more quickly scorches the target. Dealing damage to a scorched target inflicts scorch.

perks.name: Explosive Head
perks.description: Arrows explode after a short delay.

enhanced.name: Explosive Head
enhanced.description: Arrows explode after a short delay. Increases accuracy.

perks.name: Binary Orbit
perks.description: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for a short duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

enhanced.name: Binary Orbit
enhanced.description: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for an improved duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

enhanced.name: Elemental Honing
enhanced.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus for an improved duration. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.description: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

enhanced.name: Swashbuckler
enhanced.description: This weapon gains increased damage for an improved duration from melee final blows and defeating targets with this weapon.

perks.name: High Ground
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks.

enhanced.name: High Ground
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks. Increases reload.
